title: WIHIC | Notice who gets a chance to be heard

interpretations.headline: Notice who gets a chance to be heard
interpretations.summary: Classroom fairness can show up in small things, including who gets called on, who gets feedback, and who has a chance to try again. These answers describe how often you noticed similar opportunities for different students.

guidance.text: If something feels unfair, you can keep a specific example and talk it through with an adult you trust. It is okay to ask someone to help.

limitations: The score is the average of all eight answers on the original five-point frequency scale. A missing response leaves this result unavailable.
The result describes one student’s experience in this class. There is no combined WIHIC score, norm, level, or ranking.
The items are from the 56-item classroom form; this illustrated report and separate digital display are project adaptations.
report.disclaimer: For research and supportive reflection on classroom experiences. Do not use for teacher appraisal, school ranking, diagnosis or student selection. Discuss concerns with a trusted adult regardless of the score. There is no combined WIHIC total.
